{{Quote|I'm sorry, Captain Solo, that's quite impossible. The ionic interference seems to be returning, and our reception is too distorted for me to record. If you were to climb a few hundred meters, I could use the static scrubbers to enhance the signal.|C-3PO to Han Solo|<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
A '''static scrubber''' was a type of equipment used to enhance communications signals affected by interference.<ref name="JK" />

In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] suggested using static scrubbers to improve the reception of a transmission from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyp Durron]] that was being distorted by ionic interference to the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="JK" />
